messages:
Lena (Billing): FYI Helix Labs (acct HLX-204) payment failed. They attempted split payment across 2 corporate cards then a bank transfer — bank returned wire as 'invalid_account'. Need triage.

billing-bot: [event] payment.attempt id=pay_9XyZ amount=20400 currency=usd status=failed reason=invalid_account gateway=wire ts=2023460010

Priya (Support): I chatted with procurement. Sequence: card A auth $12,240 -> card B auth $8,160 -> multiple holds hit fraud filter -> issuer sent 3DS challenge which procurement didn't complete. Then procurement tried wire using IBAN they copied from an old doc and got returned. They want clear next steps.

Omar (Finance): Rough plan: 1) cancel stale auths to release holds, 2) provide corrected wire + request proof of payment after send, 3) offer temporary credit hold so product isn't suspended while collecting. Also ask for W-9 before wire (compliance).

Lena (Billing): Cancelled auths: 
```
stripe.auth.cancel(ids=[auth_12A,auth_34B]) -> ok
```
Holds released. Noted wire returned code RTN42.

billing-bot: [event] authorizations.cancelled ids=[auth_12A,auth_34B] ts=2023460122

Priya (Support): Procurement says they can re-initiate wire but procurement lead needs W-9 and corrected IBAN. I gave them a secure upload link.

Tariq (Sales): Strong preference to avoid churn — happy to approve temporary access while we clear payment if they provide earnest PO and proof of upcoming wire. Approving 5 business days grace. :+1:

Legal-bot: [reminder] vendor-docs-needed HLX-204: W-9 required for domestic wire amount > $10k. Upload link: https://secure.redwood/w9-upload

Omar (Finance): Noted. For the wire, I'll send a signed wire instructions PDF with a unique reference code to avoid miscopy: REF-HLX204-2023. Also mark invoice INV-6021 as manual_collect_inprogress.

Lena (Billing): Invoice flags set: [manual_collect_inprogress, sales_grace_5d]. Added note: "Do not suspend until 5 business days unless non-payment confirmed."

billing-bot: [event] invoice.updated id=INV-6021 flags=[manual_collect_inprogress,sales_grace_5d] ts=2023460205

Priya (Support): Follow-up with procurement: please upload W-9, confirm you will initiate wire with reference REF-HLX204-2023, and attach sender BIC/beneficiary name. Also suggested they try card retry only if they can complete 3DS.

Helix Procurement (via Priya): Will upload W-9 today and re-initiate wire tomorrow morning. We had the wrong IBAN — thanks for the PDF.

Omar (Finance): Action items recap: 1) Lena cancels auths (done), 2) I send signed wire PDF to procurement and compliance link for W-9, 3) Sales grace approved by Tariq, 4) Support to monitor proof of payment and confirm when funds clear.

Lena (Billing): I'll set a 72h payment-monitoring alert and create follow-up if no proof by then.

Priya (Support): Marking follow-ups at +24h (W-9), +48h (wire init), +72h (clear).

Tariq (Sales): If they still struggle, offer ACH as alternative but require verification window. Keep me in the loop.

Lena (Billing): Thanks all. I'll post updates here as we get the W-9/upload and proof of wire. :v:
